card.line: Beth-shan was a city where the Philistines hung King Saul's body after he died in battle, and where brave men from Jabesh-gilead came to take it down.

moments.title: Saul's body hung on the wall
moments.text: After Saul died, the Philistines put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths. They hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

moments.title: Brave men take the bodies
moments.text: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard the news, their men of valor traveled all night. They took the bodies of Saul and his sons down from the wall of Beth-shan.
